abilities.name: Misha, Focus!
abilities.description: Passive Misha gains 15% Movement Speed. Command Misha to attack a specific enemy or move to a point and wait. Targeting Rexxar commands Misha to retreat to his position, gaining 30% move speed until she reaches Rexxar. Targeting Misha commands her to hold her current position. Misha

fields.notes: Killing Misha rewards a Takedown credit and 0.25 Hero kills/XP. When Misha is dead, killing Rexxar rewards a Takedown credit and 0.75 Hero kills/XP. If Misha is alive while Rexxar is killed, she dies as well, totaling a full Hero kill/XP and two Takedown credits. Misha's death timer is 14s+.5s/level. Rexxar becomes unable to control Misha while he is unable to act (Stunned, Dazed or put in Time Stop or Stasis, other than Feign Death) or Silenced. If Rexxar enters a Vehicle or is some other way removed from the battleground, Misha will be removed from the Battleground as well. Issuing Move and Attack commands to Misha doesn't dismount or break objective channels, hearthstone or dismount, but using Abilities will. Rexxar and Misha share the effects of Healing Fountains. Both Rexxar and Misha can pick up Regeneration Globes, but their effect is not shared. Misha's passive Movement Speed bonus does not stack with other Movement Speed bonuses, including the bonus from the 'return' command. When Rexxar is Mounted, Misha's Movement Speed bonus is increased to 30% while she is within 6 radius.
